description: Gets (or creates) a permanent deposit address for a coin/network and optional customer_ref: the same address comes back for the same customer_ref. Every transfer to it is credited to your balance in USDT as a separate payment — good for top-ups. Networks: list_static_address_networks.

asset.description: Code from list_static_address_networks, e.g. "usdt.trc20", or a coin symbol with network.

customer_ref.description: Your customer id: one address per customer.

network.description: Network when asset is a bare symbol, e.g. "polygon".

name: create_static_address
title: Permanent deposit address
